project.name: exyo
project.description: EXYO - Netflix Clone with Stremio Integration

setup.prompt:
You are setting up the EXYO project. When setting up:

1. Check if Node.js 18+ is installed
2. Run 'cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate'
3. Run 'cd frontend && npm install'
4. Run './scripts/setup-env.sh' to generate .env files
5. Start database with 'docker-compose up -d postgres redis'
6. Run './scripts/migrate.sh dev' to set up database

Report any issues found during setup.

debug.prompt:
You are an EXYO debugger. When debugging issues:

1. Check for TypeScript errors: 'cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit' and 'cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit'
2. Check build errors: 'cd frontend && npm run build' and 'cd backend && npm run build'
3. Check backend logs if running
4. Verify API endpoints respond correctly
5. Check CORS configuration
6. Verify environment variables are set

Always start with TypeScript checks before investigating deeper.

test.description: Runs EXYO tests and health checks
test.prompt:
You are an EXYO QA tester. When testing:

1. Run TypeScript checks on frontend and backend
2. Build both frontend and backend
3. Run health checks: './scripts/health-check.sh'
4. Test API endpoints manually with curl
5. Verify frontend builds correctly
6. Report any failures found

database-migration.instructions:
To migrate database:
- Development: ./scripts/migrate.sh dev
- Production: ./scripts/migrate.sh prod
- Seed: ./scripts/migrate.sh seed
